title: Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture

result.label: Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture
result.statement: Every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension with no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is therefore projective. This proves Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler setting.
